contractChanges.change: The availability definition (src/lab/evidenceAvailability.ts) moved from evidence-availability.v1 to evidence-availability.v2-stance-aware. Two changes: (1) FIELD SCOPE widened from explicitPreferences/explicitDislikes to all four inference-visible fields (resumeText, explicitPreferences, explicitDislikes, contradictoryStatements), matching what src/lab/evaluate.ts actually passes to the engine; (2) STANCE AWARENESS added, so a placement's direction is intendedDirection(behaviour side, LIKE/DISLIKE stance) rather than the phrase's pole alone.
contractChanges.reasonNotAMetricImprovement: This is a CORRECTNESS repair, not a tuning change. The v1 definition labelled 'a low-side phrase appears in explicitDislikes' as low-side evidence, but a dislike of low-side behaviour means HIGH. It therefore admitted semantically backwards evidence into the denominator, and it excluded genuine evidence the inference system receives through resumeText and contradictoryStatements. Neither change was selected to move a number.
contractChanges.measuredEffect: DEVELOPMENT availableEligibleCoverage 0.4767 -> 0.3300. AVAILABLE_EVIDENCE_PREFERENCE_MACRO_MAE_V1 2.5325 -> 2.4152, which for the first time beats the constant-5 companion (2.4961); under v1 the decoder was WORSE than constant-5 (2.5325 vs 2.4855) because it was being graded against backwards evidence.
contractChanges.reviewRequirement: Availability is a POLICY/CONTRACT surface. Any further change to INFERENCE_VISIBLE_PREFERENCE_FIELDS, the stance lexicon, or the phrase catalog is a metric-contract change requiring the same review as changing the metric itself, and must be recorded here. It is never a decoder experiment.

contractChanges.change: The observation generator no longer emits semantically backwards preference language. Preference direction is now f(behaviour side, LIKE/DISLIKE stance) (src/lab/preferenceSemantics.ts), and dimension selection shuffles before truncating instead of DIMENSION_IDS.filter(...).slice(0, N).
contractChanges.reasonNotAMetricImprovement: The pre-fix generator paired a LOW hidden truth with a dislike of LOW-side behaviour ('I avoid solo deep work'), which means HIGH. Over 261 such DEVELOPMENT placements, mean truth was 2.68 against mean prediction 5.64, and directional accuracy was 0.147 -- worse than chance. Every preference number computed before this fix graded the decoder against contradictory evidence.
contractChanges.measuredEffect: RECOGNIZED_EVIDENCE_PREFERENCE_MACRO_MAE 2.5724 -> 1.7189. LEGACY_ALL_DIMENSION_MAE 1.9009 -> 1.7357. Best shrinkage lambda moved from below 1 to exactly 1, so shrinking toward the neutral prior no longer pays.
contractChanges.reviewRequirement: Generator semantics are gated by pnpm eval:generator-monotonicity, which reads meaning from the RENDERED TEXT and exits nonzero on any backwards statement. Changing the phrase catalog or the expressibility thresholds is a metric-contract change.

contractChanges.change: The four observable sources (career narrative, explicit preference list, explicit dislike list, contradictory statements) are now distinct. src/lab/evaluate.ts no longer concatenates the lists into careerText while also passing them separately, the generator assigns each statement to exactly one source, and extractEvidence suppresses exact-normalized cross-source repeats.
contractChanges.reasonNotAMetricImprovement: One generated statement previously produced two evidence items, inflating the dependence-aware effective-signal count that drives both evidence weight and confidence. Removing double counting removes signal the decoder had been getting for free; it made prediction variance FALL, which is the opposite of what a tuning change would do.
contractChanges.measuredEffect: 0 of 150 DEVELOPMENT subjects now show a within-field or cross-source duplicate. Prediction variance ratio fell 0.1333 -> 0.0964, so VARIANCE_COLLAPSE now fires. This is reported, not tuned away.
contractChanges.reviewRequirement: Exact-normalized only. Paraphrase and common-source duplication remain unresolved and are tracked as an open research question, not a solved problem.

metrics.name: AVAILABLE_EVIDENCE_PREFERENCE_MACRO_MAE_V1
metrics.construct: continuous interpretation of GENERATOR-EXPOSED evidence for explicitly eligible preference dimensions, independent of extractor recognition
metrics.prediction: inferred value for measurable_feedback or experimentation_preference
metrics.groundTruth: synthetic hidden preference for the same eligible dimension, included whenever the observation generator exposed preference language for it in an inference-visible field (resumeText, explicitPreferences, explicitDislikes, contradictoryStatements) whose MEANING is directional once behaviour side and LIKE/DISLIKE stance are combined (src/lab/evidenceAvailability.ts, evidence-availability.v2-stance-aware), whether or not the extractor recognized it
metrics.observationUnit: eligible subject with at least one available-evidence eligible dimension
metrics.aggregation: available-evidence eligible dimension MAE within subject, then equal subject mean
knownFailureModes: stance-lexicon drift: widening the evaluation stance markers would admit more placements and is a contract change, not a decoder experiment
metrics.forbiddenInterpretation: full 17D profile, job fit, mapper accuracy, extractor recall, or human validity
metrics.governanceNote: Supersedes AUTONOMOUS_OBSERVED_PREFERENCE_MACRO_MAE_V1 (see that record's status below) because a recognized-evidence-gated denominator lets the algorithm under test shrink its own denominator by recognizing fewer cases -- a selection-bias/Goodhart path. The extractor recognizing fewer cases MUST NOT remove a subject/dimension from this metric's denominator; see tests/available-evidence.test.ts. The availability definition itself moved to v2 stance-aware on 2026-08-23; see contractChanges.availability-v2-stance-aware.

metrics.name: AVAILABLE_EVIDENCE_PREFERENCE_MICRO_MAE
metrics.construct: flat interpretation error over generator-exposed eligible-dimension records
metrics.groundTruth: same available-evidence-gated synthetic truth as the macro metric
knownFailureModes: subjects with more available evidence dominate
metrics.allowedUse: mandatory companion to the primary metric

metrics.name: RECOGNIZED_EVIDENCE_PREFERENCE_MACRO_MAE
metrics.construct: continuous interpretation error restricted to cases the extractor itself recognized as PREFERENCE/DISLIKE evidence for the dimension
metrics.prediction: inferred value for measurable_feedback or experimentation_preference
metrics.groundTruth: synthetic hidden preference restricted to profile.evidence -> inferredTaskDimensions recognition
metrics.aggregation: recognized eligible dimension MAE within subject, then equal subject mean
knownFailureModes: extractor can shrink its own denominator by recognizing less
not a substitute for the primary metric
metrics.allowedUse: extractor-recall diagnostic; compare against AVAILABLE_EVIDENCE_PREFERENCE_MACRO_MAE_V1, never report alone
metrics.forbiddenInterpretation: primary decoder quality claim; full 17D profile; human validity

metrics.name: RECOGNIZED_EVIDENCE_PREFERENCE_MICRO_MAE
metrics.construct: flat interpretation error over extractor-recognized eligible-dimension records
metrics.groundTruth: same recognized-evidence-gated synthetic truth as RECOGNIZED_EVIDENCE_PREFERENCE_MACRO_MAE
knownFailureModes: subjects with more recognized evidence dominate

metrics.name: AVAILABLE_TO_RECOGNIZED_RECALL
metrics.construct: extractor recall conditional on generator exposure: of eligible-dimension records where evidence was actually available, what fraction did the extractor recognize
metrics.prediction: not applicable (diagnostic ratio, not a decoder prediction)
metrics.groundTruth: availability label from src/lab/evidenceAvailability.ts intersected with extractor recognition
metrics.scale: rate 0-1, or null when no available-evidence records exist
knownFailureModes: can be gamed upward only by improving true recognition, never by hiding evidence, since the denominator is availability-fixed
metrics.allowedUse: extractor recall/coverage diagnostic, mandatory companion to the primary metric

metrics.name: ZERO_AVAILABLE_EVIDENCE_MAE
metrics.construct: decoder behavior on eligible dimensions where the generator exposed no preference/dislike evidence at all
metrics.prediction: inferred dimension value (typically the neutral prior)
metrics.groundTruth: unobserved-by-design generator latent value for eligible dimensions with no available evidence
knownFailureModes: truth not observable by design, so improving this number is not meaningful decoder progress
metrics.forbiddenInterpretation: evidence extraction accuracy; decoder interpretation quality

metrics.name: AUTONOMOUS_OBSERVED_PREFERENCE_MACRO_MAE_V1
metrics.construct: SUPERSEDED: continuous interpretation of supported evidence for explicitly eligible preference dimensions, where inclusion depended on extractor recognition
metrics.prediction: inferred value for measurable_feedback or experimentation_preference
metrics.groundTruth: synthetic hidden preference for the same generator-observed and extractor-supported dimension
metrics.aggregation: supported (extractor-recognized) eligible dimension MAE within subject, then equal subject mean
knownFailureModes: SELECTION BIAS: the extractor under test can shrink this metric's own denominator by recognizing fewer cases (Goodhart path)
metrics.allowedUse: SUPERSEDED as of the readiness-hardening audit. Retained only under `legacySuperseded` in diagnostic reports for before/after comparison. Do NOT use as the primary autonomous synthetic preference-decoder metric.
metrics.forbiddenInterpretation: primary metric; full 17D profile; job fit; mapper accuracy; or human validity

metrics.name: LEGACY_ALL_DIMENSION_MAE
metrics.aggregation: mean over 17 dimensions per subject, then equal subject mean
metrics.forbiddenInterpretation: recommendation, fit, mapping, or human validity

metrics.name: OBSERVED_PREFERENCE_MACRO_MAE
metrics.construct: SUPERSEDED (all-17-dimension, extractor-recognition-gated): interpretation of recognized preference/dislike evidence, not scoped to the eligible dimension set
metrics.groundTruth: synthetic truth only where PREFERENCE/DISLIKE evidence produced a dimension signal
metrics.aggregation: within-subject mean recognized-dimension error, then equal mean over subjects
knownFailureModes: generator phrase semantics may be invalid
metrics.allowedUse: SUPERSEDED. Reported as `legacySuperseded.allDimensionRecognizedMacroMae` for comparison only.
metrics.forbiddenInterpretation: primary metric; full profile, job fit, or human validity

metrics.name: OBSERVED_PREFERENCE_MICRO_MAE
metrics.construct: SUPERSEDED (all-17-dimension, extractor-recognition-gated): flat recognized evidence interpretation
metrics.allowedUse: SUPERSEDED. Reported as `legacySuperseded.allDimensionRecognizedMicroMae` for comparison only.

metrics.name: ZERO_EVIDENCE_MAE
metrics.construct: SUPERSEDED (all-17-dimension, extractor-recognition-gated): behavior without recognized preference support
metrics.allowedUse: SUPERSEDED. Reported as `legacySuperseded.allDimensionZeroRecognizedMae` for comparison only. Use ZERO_AVAILABLE_EVIDENCE_MAE for the availability-gated analog.

metrics.name: TASK_MAPPING_TOP1_RECALL_AT_K
metrics.aggregation: top-1, recall@K, coverage and correct-abstention rates

metrics.name: PRODUCT_RECOMMENDATION_VALIDITY
metrics.forbiddenInterpretation: no current synthetic metric establishes it
